F_oxygen.adequacy: Adequate oxygen availability for lactate production is effective_oxygen_deficit == 0 (ADEQUATE and COMPENSATED); CRITICAL is effective_oxygen_deficit > 0. Normal resting DO2 is not required.

faculty.adequacy: Adequate oxygen availability for lactate production is effective_oxygen_deficit == 0 (ADEQUATE and COMPENSATED); CRITICAL is effective_oxygen_deficit > 0. Normal resting DO2 is not required.
faculty.l3: fraction_with_ppi 0.8 and fraction_after_hemostasis 0.1: FIXED_PROVISIONAL_FOR_PRIMARY_LACTATE_ANALYSIS and FACULTY_DECISION_PENDING. No range exists, so there is no sensitivity on them.
faculty.preload: Primary support 57m 0.5 and 72f 0.6; a lower position enters only where it survives the current blood constraints; the positions that enter are reported exactly.
faculty.rates: Bleed rates 2.5, 5 and 6 mL-eq/min; none is approved; 7 and above are excluded.
faculty.readiness: The open crystalloid tau edge does not block the lactate rebuild: readiness becomes READY_FOR_CURRENT_PHYSIOLOGY_LACTATE_REBUILD_WITH_PROPAGATED_FLUID_UNCERTAINTY. This approves no tau value.
faculty.recovery: FD-LAC-06 with active bleeding: PERSISTENT_OR_WORSENING_CRITICAL when the deficit > 0 is stable or worsening over the reassessment interval; RECOVERING_CRITICAL when the deficit > 0 decreases over it, and lactate may fall. The net trajectory at the reassessment points decides, not minute-to-minute monotonicity. No active treatment order is required; no percentage tolerance is added to the deficit.
faculty.tau: tau is STRUCTURALLY_IDENTIFIABLE BUT PRACTICALLY_WEAKLY_IDENTIFIED_WITHIN_120_MIN_HORIZON. Every certified crystalloid point propagates as fluid uncertainty; no preferred tau is chosen and nothing above 240 min is added.

debt_per_delivery_deficit.structural: only G x g (and G x arrival debt) reaches lactate

lactate_per_output_deficit.structural: only G x g (and G x arrival debt) reaches lactate

reserve.structural: rho cancels in the deficit, D, lactate and adequacy (ratio re-anchored as ratio / rho)

identifiability.rule: On the survivors, per dimension, against the values present in the source space (the reserve read from each P3 set's reserves): one value explored = NOT_VARIED; one left = WELL_CONSTRAINED; some excluded = PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED; none excluded = POORLY_IDENTIFIED; structural = NON_IDENTIFIABLE_SEPARATELY (G and g reach lactate only as G x g with G x arrival debt; rho cancels). Edge status: INTERIOR / OPEN_* of blood_extension.edge_status on varied numeric or band-level dimensions (lower < midpoint < upper). No value is chosen by its frequency.

lactate_side.demand: metabolic_demand_baseline is not variable: the registry has no candidate point for it (1 for uncomplicated haemorrhage; never a free parameter for lactate) and calibration.case_values fixes 1.0. The earlier draft's 0.9 / 1.1 sensitivity is not a registry range and is not applied.
lactate_side.intrinsic: intrinsic_sinus_rate stays at its band midpoint: it reaches no haemodynamics, D or lactate (checked).

legacy_reference.rule: LEGACY REFERENCE, NOT A CALIBRATION TARGET: the family engine's own lactate at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90 and 120 min, read after the filter and the representatives, never by a constraint or an ordering.

policy: Shadow only. Current certified physiology only: the P2F historical region is never read (P2FGuard). Blood constraints and FD-BLD envelopes are the frozen ones; FD-LAC-02..05 are faculty_constraints' frozen functions; FD-LAC-01 and 06 read the faculty's 2026-10-28 recovery semantics; adequacy is deficit == 0. The crystalloid support propagates whole; no tau is preferred. Haemodynamics are simulated once and D and lactate post-processed exactly (validated against full runs, else stop). Filter order L1, L3, L2. The legacy lactate is read after the filter only. Nothing is fitted, selected or approved; no SBP, MAP or HR is calibrated; collapse stays off.

readiness.faculty: The open crystalloid tau edge does not block the lactate rebuild: readiness becomes READY_FOR_CURRENT_PHYSIOLOGY_LACTATE_REBUILD_WITH_PROPAGATED_FLUID_UNCERTAINTY. This approves no tau value.

region.status: FACULTY-CONSTRAINED CURRENT-PHYSIOLOGY LACTATE REGION (no value selected or approved)

source.reproduction_rule: Each certified count is compared only with the source's survivors at the refill pairs and the positions that certified run explored (P2I-2W's boxes fixed the upper positions). It must agree exactly; and no survivor may lie at an explored (rate, refill pair, positions) cell that no certified count covers. Survivors at positions a certified run never explored enter by the faculty's preload rule (they meet every current blood constraint) and are reported apart as beyond the certified exploration.

fd04_sensitivity.note: sensitivity only: survivors that would also pass FD-LAC-04 with the fall required at the threshold; never filters

persistent_critical_decline_after_haemos.note: reported, never filtered: FD-LAC-06 judges active bleeding only; L3 runs with a sustained substantial lactate fall during a persistent or worsening deficit after haemostasis

recovering_declines_allowed.note: survivors whose run had a sustained substantial decline that the current semantics allowed as RECOVERING_CRITICAL

structural_products.rule: lactate = baseline + X0 a^t + G D0 W1(tau_D, tau_L) + G g W2(tau_D, tau_L, deficit): only G x g and G x D0 reach it

validation.rule: Blood sets: per rate the first, middle (floor(n / 2)) and last P3 set in source order. Lactate side: indices 0, n/4, n/2, 3n/4, n-1 (floor) and the canonical point (tau_D 60, g 1, G 6, tau_L 120, midpoint excess, midpoint pair). Scenarios L1, L3 and L2 at the first and last crystalloid point, both cases, reserve 2.5 and intrinsic midpoint: exact equality of every minute's lactate, D and deficit, of haemostasis and stop. On the canonical point also reserve 1 and 3 (1e-9 and identical FD-LAC verdicts) and intrinsic lower / upper (exact). Any disagreement stops the run.

verdict.next_domain: Recommended next domain (not started; needs its own authorization): blood-pressure and heart-rate calibration of the shadow core on the faculty-constrained blood, crystalloid and lactate region, before collapse, GI migration or any runtime integration.
verdict.rule: LACTATE_CALIBRATION_CONSTRAINTS_SATISFIED when readiness is the faculty's READY, the blood source reproduces the certified counts, its keys are certified for the crystalloid support, the factorization agrees with the full core, at least one candidate survives, and among the survivors FD-LAC-04 and FD-LAC-05 are actually evaluated (PASS or ALREADY_NORMALIZED) in both cases for at least one candidate, so the definitive-management constraints are not met only as NOT_EVALUABLE. Otherwise LACTATE_NOT_READY with the first blocker. No candidate, value or parameter is selected or approved.
